title: [CQ-M07r] moe-agent.sh: under verified-local, a worktree completion runs its owed checks in check VMs, never the host gate
description:
Slice of CQ-M07 (task-1a8f1d0e199046a289e94a5453d758b8, the final acceptance row). Filed by its planner architect-c33f294e on 2026-11-04. Design decisions: mem:decision-cq-m07-verified-local-activation (settled by the human; do not re-ask).

WHY
- Under verified-local a required check counts only as an authenticated runner observation: a CheckDispatch plus a CheckObservation over /runner (delivery/policy.ts trustedPassedOn). A moe.record_check_run report never counts.
- Nothing produces such an observation today. scripts/local-runner/check-dispatch.mjs (CQ-V04b) has no caller outside its tests (docs/ARCHITECTURE.md: "nothing invokes it per candidate yet").
- The worktree completion's L6 (wt_land_rounds in scripts/moe-agent.sh, about line 7719) runs the qualityGate ON THE HOST on the candidate's merged tree (run_frozen_gate worktree). So a VM seat's code runs on the host, and its pass is still not evidence.
- Result: every verified-local task is refused at qa_approve, and the host executes candidate code.

OBJECTIVE. Under the strong profile (strong_landing_task: verified-local read from the attempt record or journal, never from the environment), L6 of a worktree completion:
1. records the frozen candidate of M on B exactly as today (freeze_candidate);
2. builds one commit object with tree M and the single parent B (git commit-tree; never published). This is also the one-commit-on-baseRevision form that check-architecture needs;
3. runs `node <SCRIPT_DIR>/local-runner/check-dispatch.mjs --project <control checkout> --task <taskId> --commit <that commit>`. It is bounded, and only fixed codes are read from its one JSON line;
4. goes on to L7 only on exit 0 (every owed check observed passed). Any other result fails the round as MOE_COMMIT_FAILED_GATE (the unlanded 'gate' route), with one line that names only the report's fixed code, and nothing is published.
The host never runs the qualityGate command for a strong task. legacy, observe and task-less landings keep run_frozen_gate worktree byte for byte.

DELIVERABLE
- scripts/moe-agent.sh: the strong L6 branch and a check-dispatch path resolver. It runs the bundled $SCRIPT_DIR/local-runner/check-dispatch.mjs. A MOE_CHECK_DISPATCH_PATH test override is honored only without MOE_RUNTIME_PROTECTED=1, mirroring MOE_AGENT_SEAT_PATH and MOE_VERIFIED_LOCAL_SEAT_PATH_IGNORED.
- scripts/tests/postflight-fake-check-dispatch.js (new): a fake dispatch CLI for the harnesses (pass, fail, stopped codes, crash, hang).
- New rows in scripts/tests/postflight-vm-route.sh.

NOT IN SCOPE: moe-agent.ps1 (CQ-M07s, the twin); delivery receipts (CQ-M07t); any daemon, check-dispatch.mjs or local-runner change; docs (CQ-M07v1/v2); trusted check-architecture installs.

PLANNER NOTES
- Parity: every landing runs the qualityGate `bash scripts/tests/parity-check.sh && npm run lint`. A new MOE_ code in a family that parity-check.sh already compares (MOE_VERIFIED_LOCAL_, MOE_SEAT_, MOE_VM_, MOE_WORKTREE_, MOE_LAND_ and the others it lists) would fail this slice's own landing until the ps1 twin lands. Reuse existing codes, or use a family parity does not compare yet; CQ-M07s then adds the twin and the family.
- The dispatch runs inside L3's git-land lease. It may take up to an hour per check (check-dispatch.mjs CHECK_BUDGET_MS). State that budget against the lease's maxLeaseMs and MOE_LAND_LEASE_WAIT_SEC.
- A code-failure observation makes the daemon's repair (delivery/repairActivation.ts) move the REVIEW task to WORKING before the wrapper's unlanded finalize_attempt runs. Pin the resulting end state (attempt closed, landingRetry, status) with a row.
- check-dispatch needs: the task's current candidate (freeze_candidate records it); an approved plan revision; an environment listed in settings.checkEnvironments; and every owed check declared with a dependency choice. An owed qualityGate that is not declared in executionContract.requiredChecks stops with RUNNER_DEPENDENCIES_UNDECLARED. Each refusal must fail closed.
- Keep CQ-M07m2's rule that a strong worktree landing needs settings.qualityGate, unless the plan states a cleaner rule.
- No seat runs Multipass: tests use the fake dispatch only.

VERIFICATION, from the task worktree with MOE_*/CLAUDE*/FAKE_* scrubbed and MOE_POSTFLIGHT_TIMEOUT_SEC=360: `bash scripts/tests/postflight.sh && bash scripts/tests/parity-check.sh && npm run lint`.
definitionOfDone: Under verified-local, a worktree completion's L6 runs check-dispatch.mjs on a commit whose tree is exactly the merged tree M and whose only parent is B, and the qualityGate command never runs on the host. A postflight-vm-route.sh row proves it with a canary gate that would write a witness file: the witness is absent, and the target moves only after the fake dispatch passes.

Every non-pass fails the round as MOE_COMMIT_FAILED_GATE with nothing published and a line that names only the fixed code. One postflight-vm-route.sh row per case: non-zero exit, a stopped report, RUNNER_NOTHING_OWED, RUNNER_DEPENDENCIES_UNDECLARED, a missing CLI, a crashing CLI and an unparsable reply.

legacy, observe and task-less worktree completions still run run_frozen_gate worktree unchanged: the existing postflight-worktree.cjs and postflight-vm-route.sh rows pass with their assertions unedited.
MOE_CHECK_DISPATCH_PATH is honored only without MOE_RUNTIME_PROTECTED=1. Under it, the bundled path runs and a warning names the ignored override. Tested.
`bash scripts/tests/postflight.sh`, `bash scripts/tests/parity-check.sh` and `npm run lint` pass from the task worktree.
taskRails: Never run a verified-local task's qualityGate or any candidate code on the host. When the check VMs cannot run the owed checks, refuse the landing.
No seat runs Multipass: tests use the fake dispatch CLI only.

comments.content:
Scope note from this row's author (architect-c33f294e, 2026-11-04). It adds one case to DoD 2's "names only the fixed code".

CQ-M07w (task-0bcc0b33) makes check-dispatch.mjs stop an unapproved environment as {code: 'RUNNER_ENVIRONMENT_NOT_APPROVED', environment: 'moe-local-vm-v1:<64 hex>'}. The operator needs that id to fill settings.checkEnvironments by hand, and no other output names it.

So the MOE_COMMIT_FAILED_GATE line also names the environment, but only when the report's stop carries one that matches /^moe-local-vm-v1:[0-9a-f]{64}$/ exactly. Any other value is never printed.
- Add a postflight-vm-route.sh row: the fake dispatch emits the field, and the line ends with environment=<id>.
- Add a second row: a malformed value prints the code alone.

This row does not depend on CQ-M07w, because the fake emits the field itself. Your fake's report shape must match CQ-M07w's DoD 1.
